title: Simulation 3D Lidar
text: 3D 仿真环境中的激光雷达传感器模型；输出 6 路；按 {Mounting location} 指定传感器安装位置；{Sensor identifier} 指定唯一传感器标识符、{Parent name} 指定父车辆名称 Scene、{Specify offset} 指定相对于安装位置的偏移、{Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)} 指定相对于安装位置的平移偏移量、{Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} 指定相对于安装位置的旋转偏移量、{Sample time} 指定采样时间、{Detection range (m)} 指定激光雷达传感器测量的最大距离、{Range resolution (m)} 指定激光雷达传感器量程的分辨率、{Vertical field of view (deg)} 指定垂直视场、{Vertical resolution (deg)} 指定垂直角分辨率、{Horizontal field of view (deg)} 指定水平视场、{Horizontal resolution (deg)} 指定水平角、{Distance outport} 输出到被测对象点的距离、{Reflectivity outport} 输出表面材质的反射率、{Output semantic segmentation} 输出标签 ID 的语义分割图、{Output location (m) and orientation (rad)} 输出传感器的位置和方向，按实例取值。

ports.name: Point cloud
ports.summary: 点云数据 m -by- n -by-3 array of positive real-valued [ x, y, z ] points

ports.name: Distance
ports.summary: 到对象点的距离 m -by- n positive real-valued matrix

ports.name: Reflectivity
ports.summary: 表面材质的反射率 m -by- n matrix of intensity values in range [0, 1]

ports.name: Labels
ports.summary: 标签标识符 m -by- n array of label identifiers

params.name: Sensor identifier
params.values: 唯一传感器标识符 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Parent name
params.values: 父车辆名称 Scene Origin (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Mounting location
params.values: 传感器安装位置 Origin (default) | Front bumper | Rear bumper | Right mirror | Left mirror | Rearview mirror | Hood center | Roof center |...

params.name: Specify offset
params.values: 指定相对于安装位置的偏移 off (default) | on

params.name: Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)
params.values: 相对于安装位置的平移偏移量 [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: 相对于安装位置的旋转偏移量 [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Detection range (m)
params.values: 激光雷达传感器测量的最大距离 120 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Range resolution (m)
params.values: 激光雷达传感器量程的分辨率 0.002 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Vertical resolution (deg)
params.values: 垂直角分辨率 1.25 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Horizontal resolution (deg)
params.values: 水平角（方位角）分辨率 0.16 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Distance outport
params.values: 输出到被测对象点的距离 off (default) | on

params.name: Reflectivity outport
params.values: 输出表面材质的反射率 off (default) | on

params.name: Output semantic segmentation
params.values: 输出标签 ID 的语义分割图 off (default) | on

params.name: Output location (m) and orientation (rad)
params.values: 输出传感器的位置和方向 off (default) | on
